Symptomatic synovial plica disease of the knee joint.

Congenital unilateral loss of cerebral cortex; presumed prenatal vascular disruption does not establish ongoing systemic vascular disease.

Named syndrome comprises cholestatic biliary disease, ataxia and visual dysfunction; precise ocular pathology and phenotype frequencies are unavailable.
Disease of cutaneous appendages, including hair, nails and skin glands; other sites or mechanisms are subtype-specific.
Familial cutaneous melanoma susceptibility is indexed to skin; glioma susceptibility is a risk and does not establish neurologic involvement.
